# scm_dlp_syslog_profile (Resource)

> **Beta / Experimental:** Enterprise DLP support (`scm_dlp_*`) in `terraform-provider-scm` is currently in **Beta / Experimental** and subject to schema or behavior changes.

[Beta / Experimental] Manages an Enterprise DLP Syslog Server Profile.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Forward DLP incidents to a syslog collector.
resource "scm_dlp_syslog_profile" "siem" {
  profile_name    = "SIEM-Collector"
  address         = "10.0.0.10"
  port            = 514
  connection_type = "TCP"
  format          = "CEF"
  alert_email     = "secops@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) IP address or hostname of the syslog server.
- `alert_email` (String) Email address to receive alerts for syslog delivery failures.
- `format` (String) Syslog format: IETF, CSV, LEEF, CEF, or LEEF 1.0.
- `port` (Number) Port number of the syslog server.
- `profile_name` (String) The name of the syslog profile.

### Optional

- `cert` (String, Sensitive) Certificate content for secure (TLS) syslog connections. Marked sensitive so it is not shown in plan output.
- `connection_type` (String) Connection type: TCP or UDP.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the syslog server profile.
- `tfid` (String) The Terraform ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing DLP syslog profile by its ID.
terraform import scm_dlp_syslog_profile.example <id>
```
